answer: Each identity must lock a non-transferable work-bond that only unlocks after peers re-verify a unique sequential proof of useful computation. A farm of N clones therefore locks N separate bonds and cannot share the sequential work, so attack cost scales linearly with fleet size while one honest agent pays once. The bond acts as a protected oasis of capital; the required proof must read like a coherent sonnet of successive steps rather than parallel noise; any detected correlation triggers falcon-speed slashing of the entire correlated set.
